name: Food Dehydrator 16 Trays Freestanding
description: Large freestanding stainless steel food dehydrator with 16 trays for drying fruit, vegetables, meat, fish and herbs in bulk. Digital control panel with temperature and timer settings, a glass door so you can check progress, rear fans for even drying, a drip tray and wheels for easy moving. About 67 x 57 x 47 cm.

name: Silicone Baby Spoons
description: Soft silicone spoon and fork set for babies and toddlers learning to feed themselves. Gentle on gums, with a short, easy-grip handle. Each pack has one spoon and one fork. Available in mint, grey, mauve, mustard, sage and coral.
